about: The release-key set cases both verifiers run (README.md "Release keys"): the node agent's readReleaseKeys (qorpera-node-agent.test.mjs) and the observer's readNodeReleaseKeys (packages/runner-orchestrator/test/runtime-node-releases.test.ts). Keys are named by letter and made fresh for each run: a to i are Ed25519, x is X25519. folder: the release-keys folder (left out: no folder), with mode (default 0755), owner "other" (owned by someone else) and entries. An entry writes one key's public PEM as <key id>.pem, mode 0444; nameOf names it after another key, name gives a literal name, mode, private (the key's private PEM), size (padded to that many bytes), link (a symlink to the file) and dir (a subfolder) change that. legacy: the legacy key file, the same way (left out: no file). A case expects either keys, the set by letter, and verifiedBy, the key that verifies a release signed by signedBy (null: none does), or error, the code that refuses the whole set.
